response.overview: 🏢 Air France Airline Madrid Office Address  Airport Passenger Service Location: Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas Airport (MAD), Terminal 2, 28042 Madrid, Spain.  Air France operates passenger services from Terminal 2 at Madrid-Barajas Airport. According to the airport's airline information, its check-in desks are located on the second floor of Terminal 2, Departures, desks 423–431. Self-service check-in machines are also available near the airline check-in desks.  This is an airport-based passenger service location, not a separately verified public walk-in Air France office in central Madrid. Check your booking confirmation and airport information screens before departure because desk assignments can change.  For general travel-related enquiries, the requested contact number is 1➵{855}➵547➵{4888}.
